observed_project_context.current_problem: Episode-local codebook / dynamic-binding correctness and J-Space causal-semantic promotion can be confounded by output/extraction-index following even when an intervention changes behavior.

external_research.source: Gao, Peng, Wakamiya, Aramaki (2026), What Does Activation Steering Control? Attribution Across Answer Encodings and Output-Sensitive Subspaces, arXiv:2608.22985
external_research.finding: Cross-Encoding Steering Evaluation freezes an intervention while changing answer encodings. In the reported experiments, a steering effect can track extraction identifiers rather than the intended semantic labels; later-layer and low-rank output-sensitive structure can retain most of that index-following effect.
external_research.project_implication: A positive behavioral steering delta under one Xeno atom/codebook encoding is insufficient to identify semantic J-Space control. The intervention must follow the semantic role under remapping rather than a fixed output/extraction index.

external_research.source: Srivastav (2026), Steering the Language Axis: From Linear Decodability to Causal Control, arXiv:2608.12334
external_research.finding: Causal steering effects in Qwen3.5-2B and Llama-3.2-1B are reported as strongly layer- and target-dependent, while equal-magnitude random perturbations provide a matched control with little effect in that setting.
external_research.project_implication: Layer/site identity and same-norm controls must remain explicit; one successful layer or direction cannot be generalized into a model-wide J-Space claim.

external_research.source: Wu, Geiger, Milliere (2025), How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?, arXiv:2505.20896
external_research.finding: The studied transformer passed through a shallow heuristic phase before developing systematic variable dereferencing; causal intervention isolated a routing mechanism only later.
external_research.project_implication: Aggregate balance or high accuracy is not sufficient evidence for episode-local binding; permutation/OOD and causal discrimination should explicitly detect heuristic/index-based phases.

external_research.finding: The official current configuration reports hidden_size=1024, 24 text layers, vocab_size=248320 and full-attention layers interleaved at indices 3,7,11,15,19,23 among linear-attention layers.
external_research.project_implication: Post-training J-Space metrology should preregister exact model revision and named layer/site instead of treating prior L19/L23 observations as timeless or architecture-independent.

core_hypothesis.hypothesis: A genuinely semantic Xeno J-Space/binding control should follow the episode-local semantic role when the visible codebook is permuted, while the selected ABI atom/extraction index changes equivariantly with that mapping.
core_hypothesis.counterhypothesis: The apparent steering/binding effect is primarily an output-sensitive extraction-index or fixed-atom effect; changing the codebook leaves the intervention coupled to the old identifier instead of the semantic role.
core_hypothesis.strong_alternative: Some fixed-index behavior could be intentionally functional if the ABI globally fixes role semantics. This alternative is not sufficient for the current Trigger-2 dynamic-binding target because current training design explicitly requires episode-local remapping and prohibits a global class-to-atom semantic shortcut.

cheapest_high_information_discriminator.name: CROSS_ENCODING_S3_STEERING_EQUIVARIANCE
preconditions: freeze exact checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/build and loader-consumption identity
freeze exact intervention vector, magnitude, activation site and decoding configuration
use family-disjoint semantic items not used to construct the vector
bind exact rendered prompt bytes and token tensor identity
use only currently admitted zero-cost execution and required experiment coordination/lease law
design: Choose a three-way semantic decision family already represented by the dynamic binder/evaluator.
Construct all six S3 episode-local mappings from semantic classes to three accepted ABI output atoms or an exact non-training proxy if atom materialization is still blocked.
For each held-out semantic item, keep underlying semantics fixed while permuting only the visible codebook/answer encoding and required rendering order under an immutable manifest.
Run BASELINE_NO_INTERVENTION and the frozen target intervention under every mapping.
Run matched SIGN_FLIP, NULL_VECTOR, ORTHOGONAL_SAME_NORM or PERMUTED_SAME_NORM controls where the current intervention protocol admits them.
Include at least one wrong-layer/off-target-site control and preserve exact layer identity.
Score semantic role and extraction/atom index separately rather than collapsing them into one accuracy number.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.promotion_rule: Do not promote a semantic J-Space causal-control claim if the intervention follows fixed extraction/atom identity materially more than the remapped semantic role, if S3 equivariance fails, or if the effect is not specific relative to matched same-norm/off-target controls.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.bounded_positive_interpretation: A pass may support model/revision/site-specific semantic-control evidence at the measured scope only. It still does not mint canonical truth, whole-HCU, whole-EntityOS or training PASS.

training_and_eval_feedback.model_target_boundary: Train/score semantic binding and candidate cognition only. Deterministic ABI validity, exact identity, authority, lease, provenance and canonical-state admission remain external oracle/gate responsibilities.
training_and_eval_feedback.shortcut_warning: A model can improve apparent symbol accuracy by learning stable output positions/indices without learning the episode-local mapping. Full S3 crossing is necessary but final rendered-byte and intervention-level cross-encoding tests remain required.

jspace_metrology_feedback.posttraining_requirement: Re-identify behaviorally relevant layer/site after checkpoint freeze; do not assume pre-FT L19/L23 remains optimal or causal after training.
jspace_metrology_feedback.semantic_vs_readout_boundary: A direction that changes the expected output atom can still be output-sensitive/readout control rather than a semantic internal workspace representation. Cross-encoding is a direct falsifier for that confound.
